integrity: An explicit 13-pattern all-order proof establishes the transversal representation; separate Python and C++17 finite checks are corroboration, not a substitute for the proof.
limitations: No claim for the separate extremal family G_n or other five-cycle blowups.
The count is for distinct vertex sets, not for all induced perfect-matching witnesses.
Closest 2014 source definition and main theorem were inspected in accessible HTML excerpts, but its entire publisher PDF was not available for a whole-document comparison.
Originality is best-knowledge and remains subject to unindexed earlier equivalent treatments.
scientific_scope: All finite labelled clique blowups C5(1,1,1,a,b) with integer a,b>=1; minimum paired domination only
title: Transversal-matroid structure of minimum paired domination in extremal five-cycle blowups
